name: @gnoverse/x402-gno
description: The gno payment mechanism for the x402 'exact' scheme. Register it on a stock x402 client and it can pay any gno chain named in an offer.
//dependencies: Versions are exact so a signed payment changes only when a dependency is deliberately bumped. @x402/core is a peer: only its types are used, and a mechanism must not pull in a second copy of the client its consumer already has.
